title: Analytic: pump-depleted SHG saturation, tanh^2 conversion (nonlinear FDFD)
description:
Phase-matched second-harmonic generation into saturation (em_fdfd_nonlinear, coupling_mode pump_depleted, Newton-Krylov): a y-periodic strip (4 rows of 10 nm, CPML along x) filled everywhere, PML included, with a birefringent medium: the E_z pump (1550 nm) sees eps_zz = 2.25, the H_z second harmonic travelling along x sees eps_yy = eps_sh, chosen so that the two 3-point lattice waves are exactly phase matched (K_2w = 2 K_w per cell; eps_sh = 2.2479). A 20 um chi2 slab (chi2_medium, crystal_class general, d23 = d34 = 25 pm/V: P_y(2w) = eps0 d E_z^2 and the back-action P_z(w) = 2 eps0 d E_y(2w) conj(E_z)) converts the pump launched by a line source of amplitude E0 = gamma_L / G_coef. The sweep runs the conversion length product Gamma L over 0.25-2.
Analytic (lattice coupled-mode theory, the reference of self-test nlfd_shg_depleted_tanh): with kappa_p = k0^2 d h / sin(K_w h) and kappa_sh = 2 cos^2(K_w h) k0^2 d h / sin(2 K_w h) (the hz centre factor included), Gamma L = E0 L sqrt(kappa_p kappa_sh); the SH at the cell centres grows as E0 kappa_ratio tanh(Gamma x / L), kappa_ratio = sqrt(kappa_sh / kappa_p), and the pump falls as E0 / cosh(Gamma L): the SH power fraction is tanh^2(Gamma L) (58 % at Gamma L = 1, 93 % at 2).
Sweep tab: eta_sh (the SH power fraction) vs gamma_L with the dashed tanh^2 curve, A_pump with the sech curve.
Derived values tab: A_sh, A_pump and eta_sh against their references; expected ~1 % (coupled-mode accuracy Gamma / K and the backward waves; to be confirmed by a first run).
Line profile tab (last sweep value, Gamma L = 2, snapshot 'channel sh'): |E| of the SH along the slab vs E0 kappa_ratio tanh(Gamma x / L).
